solutions.title: Parent map BFS
solutions.strategy: Record parent pointers, then BFS from the target over left, right, and parent edges.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node is visited a constant number of times.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Parent map, queue, and visited set can store every node.

solutions.title: Distance DFS
solutions.strategy: Recursively find target distance from each ancestor and collect downward nodes from the opposite branch at the remaining distance.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each node participates in at most a constant amount of traversal.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The recursion stack is tree height, excluding the output list.
